items.title: Return completed damage questionnaire and wildlife-damage certificate
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: Letter date is 21.11.2026 (a Saturday). The period runs 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens', i.e. starting the day after the letter's date (22.11.2026, a Sunday), per the general German counting rule analogous to §187 BGB. The letter itself defines 'Werktage' as Monday through Saturday excluding statutory public holidays (so Sundays do not count, but Saturdays do). Counting forward from 23.11.2026: Werktag 1 = Mon 23.11, 2 = Tue 24.11, 3 = Wed 25.11, 4 = Thu 26.11, 5 = Fri 27.11, 6 = Sat 28.11 (Sun 29.11 skipped), 7 = Mon 30.11, 8 = Tue 01.12, 9 = Wed 02.12, 10 = Thu 03.12, 11 = Fri 04.12, 12 = Sat 05.12 (Sun 06.12 skipped), 13 = Mon 07.12.2026. There are no NRW public holidays in this window (next is 25.12). The 13th Werktag, 07.12.2026, is therefore the last day the form must reach the insurer.
